proposed.text: A wet standpipe system's hose outlet must deliver water at what minimum flow rate and pressure combination at the most hydraulically disadvantaged outlet?

options.text: 150 liters per minute at 1.5 kilograms per square centimeter minimum pressure

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Sec. 1212 establishes the wet standpipe performance standard as 190 L/min at a minimum residual pressure of 2.0 kg/sq.cm at the hydraulically most disadvantaged outlet.
proposed.explanation: The 190 L/min at 2.0 kg/sq.cm represents the minimum acceptable fire-fighting flow at the worst-case outlet (typically the highest floor, farthest from the pump). Systems must be designed to exceed this at all other outlets when this condition is met.
